class.name: CubismModelResource
class.brief_description: Serializable imported model data shared by independent runtimes.
class.description: Contains validated source metadata, ordered animation catalogs and real texture/audio/extension resource edges. Constructing or loading this resource does not create a live SDK model. Runtime nodes validate and snapshot it, keep their own native state and must not mutate shared descriptor data during playback. Setters emit [signal Resource.changed] but do not validate arbitrary manually supplied data. Reimport sources and reload affected nodes when changing import policy; saving a resource alone is not proof of a valid model or export.

method.name: get_mask_quality
method.description: Reads [code]rendering/mask_quality[/code] from [member import_options]. Returns Low=0, Medium=1 or High=2; an absent entry defaults to Medium and an invalid value returns -1. Runtime loading rejects invalid policy.

method.name: get_premultiplied_alpha
method.description: Reads [code]rendering/premultiplied_alpha[/code] from [member import_options], defaulting to false. Runtime/export validation separately reject malformed policy or texture encoding mismatches. This query does not transform texture pixels.
